name: heronhex
description: Read-only MCP servers and skills for free public U.S. higher-education data.

plugins.name: heronhex-highered
plugins.description: Read-only access to free public U.S. higher-education data: institution profiles, enrollment, retention and finance, Title IV risk flags, Single Audit findings, accreditation, research and state funding, and wages and program-to-job alignment. Five local servers plus skills; no data is hosted or collected. Runs locally in Claude Code and Cowork.

plugins.name: heronhex-highered-hosted
plugins.description: The same six skills, connected to the Heron & Hex hosted connector (https://mcp.heronhex.com/mcp) instead of local servers: nothing to install, no keys, no sign-in. Works in Claude Code, Cowork, Claude.ai and Claude Desktop.
